free_tier.stated: no free GPU tier is published; the RTX 4090 page read on 2026-11-03 gives a price per hour of USD 0.41 to USD 0.45, set by independent providers, billed by the minute with no contract or minimum spend; the rent page lists H100, A100 and L40S models at list prices (H100 SXM USD 2.40 per hour, A100 80GB PCIe USD 1.90, L40S USD 0.65) with none available right now, and the pricing page's GPU table is empty in a static read. The same account has a free trial of 250,000 inference tokens on a free key.
free_tier.notes: the GPU table on the pricing page needs JavaScript; the card page was read instead. Spot machines can be taken back by the owner with two minutes' notice

per_object_cap.notes: a whole machine with the card in it, not a slice

egress.terms: not published on the pages read

interface_detail: inferred from the docs, which describe Jupyter Lab in the browser or SSH from a terminal; not probed
tooling: JupyterLab or SSH on a rented machine; an OpenAI-compatible inference API with prlc_ keys; a Blender rendering beta
chaining: Per-minute RTX 4090 rentals from independent hosts plus an inference API on the same credit balance.
limits_note: No quota is stated; a 1-hour balance is needed up front and a rental stops when credits cannot cover the next minute.
binding_note: No quota is stated; a 1-hour balance is needed up front and a rental stops when credits cannot cover the next minute.

identity_cost.detail: Sign in with Google or a one-time email code; a short 1-hour balance is required up front, topped up by card, by a USDC transfer or from a connected USDC or USDT wallet. No phone or ID document is stated on the pages read.

reliability_note: The docs state that a rental not answering within 5 minutes is closed without charge, and that after 15 minutes of failure it is ended; a machine whose credits run out is stopped and wiped.
